description: Create an automated task on an instance, such as a nightly restart, a recurring backup, or a console command that runs on a server event. The task is enabled as soon as it is created and will act on the live server, so confirm the schedule with the user first. Call list_tasks afterwards to verify it.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be created, restating the trigger, the timezone, and each job in plain language and getting their approval.

days.description: schedule only: weekday names (for example "monday") or ints where 0 is Sunday.

events.description: event only: server events that trigger this task.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

jobs.description: Ordered jobs to run strictly from first to last each time the task fires. Preserve the user-requested order.

arg.description: Argument for jobs that need one: the console command for status.input, a URL for the webhook jobs, whole minutes (1-60) for utility.wait, and "halt" (graceful) or "kill" (force) for status.stop. Omit for jobs that take no argument.

type.description: What this job does. Available jobs: status.start: Start server. status.stop: Stop server. status.restart: Restart server. status.input: Run console command. files.backup: Create backup. utility.wait: Pause/wait. utility.webhook: POST to a webhook URL. utility.discord_webhook: POST to a Discord webhook URL.

minutes.description: timer only: minutes between runs, added to hours.

name.description: Short, human-readable title shown in the panel. Use spaces and title case, not underscores or identifier-style names.

timezone.description: schedule only: IANA timezone for the days and times. Defaults to the instance's own timezone, or UTC when it has none.

type.description: schedule runs on chosen days at clock times, timer repeats from midnight, event runs when a server event fires.

name: create_task
title: Create Automated Task
